name: Scorching Greater Witchfire · Cold
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and explodes in a 6.09-block radius on hit. Effects:
• Damage 6.25 ❤ fire + 2.25 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 32.4 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 6.75 s
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Slowness III for 9 s
